historical_commentary.text: This note captures 4D's mid-2000s investment in native XML/XSLT tooling at a time when XML was the dominant structured-data exchange format; 4D's XML and XSLT-related commands introduced in this era are still present in the current 4D language and technically functional. However, the broader industry has since largely superseded XML/XSLT with JSON for data interchange and web APIs, and 4D itself added native JSON parsing and manipulation commands (mid-2010s onward) that most modern 4D developers now reach for instead of XSLT transformations for everyday data conversion tasks.
related_updates: 4D added native JSON support to its language, which now handles most lightweight data-interchange needs XSLT once served
Industry-wide, JSON has replaced XML/XSLT as the default format for web APIs and data exchange
